items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: He’s the drummer and he’s just great. He’s part of the original Basie band and he’s very good.

ctx.x: He’s the drummer and he’s just great. He’s part of the original Basie band and he’s very good.
I’m so pleased that Bill Hughes has risen to that thing, because he’s been in that band since the fifties.
